product.name: Real Estate Development
product.description: Acquisition and development of land to build real estate projects including residential, commercial, and mixed-use properties.

product.name: Property and Facilities Management
product.description: Management and maintenance of real estate properties and facilities to optimize asset performance and operational efficiency.

product.name: Infrastructure Development and Contracting
product.description: Construction and maintenance of infrastructure including roads, bridges, water, sewage, power, and gas networks.

product.name: Construction Services
product.description: Construction of residential, commercial, hospitality, and entertainment buildings using modern technologies.

product.name: Real Estate Sales and Leasing
product.description: Sale and lease of residential villas, land, offices, and showrooms under structured contracts.

product.name: Hotel Development and Management
product.description: Development and operation of hotels, including a planned Autograph Collection hotel in Riyadh with 280 rooms.
